info.name: Matillion DPC Agents ETL Groups & Projects API

description.content:
Specification of the Matillion APIs. Two surfaces are documented: the Data Productivity Cloud (DPC) API, an OAuth2 client-credentials REST control plane for projects, environments, pipeline executions, schedules, and Agents; and the legacy instance-hosted Matillion ETL API, an HTTP Basic REST API for groups, projects, versions, jobs, tasks, and schedules. The DPC control plane is regional - use the eu1 or us1 host. Branches on the Data Productivity Cloud are managed in the UI only and are not exposed as a public API. Note: in 2026 the DPC API documentation was rebranded to docs.maia.ai ("Maia"); the runtime hosts below are unchanged.
